title: Hannah McRoberts flying saucer photo
summary: Clas Svahn tells of Hannah McRoberts flying saucer photo, about October 8, 1981 at Vancouver Island, Canada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A UFO researcher and archivist named Clas Svahn tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a woman named Hannah McRoberts, who on October 8, 1981, was driving with her husband on Vancouver Island in Canada and stopped to photograph a well-known mountain. According to Svahn, her photo appears to show a flying saucer, and the case was featured in a publication called Files of the Unexplained. If true, a solid object was caught on camera by ordinary travellers.
